purpose: Third-pass official-source verification for five still-open Batch-51 identity or current-status conflicts. The same V53 task remains unclaimed; no second runner, checkpoint advancement, exact-parcel promotion or parcel-value publication is performed.

method.official_source_policy: Only first-party operator pages, Companies House and local-authority routes are promoted. A registered office or active company does not alone prove lease continuation or physical occupation.
method.historical_status_policy: Auction Sold, Sold Prior, Withdrawn or Archive labels remain historical statements.
method.parcel_binding_policy: NO_DATA_NOT_INFERRED until exact title or canonical geometry is read.
